name: Wazuh · Honeypot Payload Analysis
description: Every 15 min: pulls honeypot events from the Wazuh indexer, dedupes payloads by content into Postgres honeypot_payloads, extracts IOCs (URLs, IPs, commands, base64), LLM-analyses each new payload once, alerts Discord on interesting ones.

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads (
  payload_hash text PRIMARY KEY,
  first_seen timestamptz,
  last_seen timestamptz,
  count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  src_ips text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  sensors text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  method text,
  path text,
  query text,
  headers jsonb,
  body text,
  detections jsonb,
  cves text[],
  categories text[],
  decoded jsonb,
  static_iocs jsonb,
  weight int,
  sample_alert_id text,
  analysis jsonb,
  interest int,
  analysed_at timestamptz,
  notified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);
ALTER TABLE honeypot_payloads ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sig_hash text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sig_text text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ioc_keys text[];
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads_last_seen_idx ON honeypot_payloads (last_seen);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads_interest_idx ON honeypot_payloads (interest);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads_pending_idx ON honeypot_payloads (weight DESC) WHERE analysed_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads_sig_idx ON honeypot_payloads (sig_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_payloads_unsigned_idx ON honeypot_payloads (payload_hash) WHERE sig_hash IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_signatures (
  sig_hash text PRIMARY KEY,
  sig_text text,
  first_seen timestamptz,
  last_seen timestamptz,
  payload_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  event_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sample_payload_hash text,
  technique text,
  alert_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_alerted timestamptz,
  last_alerted timestamptz
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS honeypot_iocs (
  ioc text PRIMARY KEY,
  first_seen timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_seen timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  payload_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_payload text,
  alerted_at timestamptz
);

INSERT INTO honeypot_payloads AS p (payload_hash, first_seen, last_seen, count, src_ips, sensors, method, path, query, headers, body, detections, cves, categories, decoded, static_iocs, weight, sample_alert_id)
SELECT md5(r.canonical), r.ts, r.ts, r.count, COALESCE(r.src_ips, '{}'), COALESCE(r.sensors, '{}'), r.method, r.path, r.query, r.headers, r.body, r.detections, r.cves, r.categories, r.decoded, r.static_iocs, r.weight, r.sample_alert_id
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(canonical text, ts timestamptz, count int, src_ips text[], sensors text[], method text, path text, query text, headers jsonb, body text, detections jsonb, cves text[], categories text[], decoded jsonb, static_iocs jsonb, weight int, sample_alert_id text)
ON CONFLICT (payload_hash) DO UPDATE SET
  first_seen = LEAST(p.first_seen, EXCLUDED.first_seen),
  last_seen = GREATEST(p.last_seen, EXCLUDED.last_seen),
  count = p.count + EXCLUDED.count,
  src_ips = (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(x), '{}') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(p.src_ips || EXCLUDED.src_ips) AS x LIMIT 500) s),
  sensors = (SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(x), '{}') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(p.sensors || EXCLUDED.sensors) AS x) s)
RETURNING payload_hash;

SELECT payload_hash, sig_hash, ioc_keys, first_seen, last_seen, count, src_ips[1:5] AS src_ips, cardinality(src_ips) AS src_ip_count, sensors, method, path, query, headers, left(body, 4000) AS body, detections, cves, categories, decoded, static_iocs, weight, sample_alert_id
FROM honeypot_payloads WHERE analysed_at IS NULL ORDER BY weight DESC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 8;

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map((i) => ({ payload_hash: i.json.payload_hash, sig_hash: i.json.sig_hash || null, ioc_keys: i.json.ioc_keys || [], analysis: i.json.analysis, interest: i.json.interest, notify: i.json.notify === true }));
return [{ json: { n: rows.length, rows: JSON.stringify(rows) } }];

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(payload_hash text, sig_hash text, ioc_keys text[], analysis jsonb, interest int, notify boolean)
), up AS (
  UPDATE honeypot_payloads AS p SET analysis = r.analysis, interest = r.interest, analysed_at = now(), notified = p.notified OR r.notify
  FROM r WHERE p.payload_hash = r.payload_hash RETURNING p.payload_hash
), sg AS (
  UPDATE honeypot_signatures g SET alert_count = g.alert_count + x.n, first_alerted = COALESCE(g.first_alerted, now()), last_alerted = now(), technique = COALESCE(x.t, g.technique)
  FROM (SELECT sig_hash, count(*) AS n, max(analysis->>'technique') AS t FROM r WHERE notify AND sig_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sig_hash) x
  WHERE g.sig_hash = x.sig_hash RETURNING g.sig_hash
), io AS (
  INSERT INTO honeypot_iocs (ioc, first_seen, last_seen, payload_count, first_payload, alerted_at)
  SELECT k, now(), now(), count(*), min(r.payload_hash), CASE WHEN bool_or(r.notify) THEN now() END
  FROM r, unnest(r.ioc_keys) AS k WHERE r.analysis->>'skipped' IS NULL GROUP BY k
  ON CONFLICT (ioc) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = now(), payload_count = honeypot_iocs.payload_count + EXCLUDED.payload_count, alerted_at = COALESCE(honeypot_iocs.alerted_at, EXCLUDED.alerted_at)
  RETURNING ioc
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM up) AS updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM sg) AS signatures_alerted, (SELECT count(*) FROM io) AS iocs;

SELECT payload_hash, method, path, query, headers, left(body, 8000) AS body, detections, static_iocs
FROM honeypot_payloads WHERE sig_hash IS NULL OR sig_text NOT LIKE 'v3 ||%' LIMIT 5000;

UPDATE honeypot_payloads AS p SET sig_text = r.sig_text, sig_hash = md5(r.sig_text), ioc_keys = COALESCE(r.ioc_keys, '{}')
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(payload_hash text, sig_text text, ioc_keys text[])
WHERE p.payload_hash = r.payload_hash
RETURNING p.payload_hash;

DELETE FROM honeypot_signatures g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM honeypot_payloads p WHERE p.sig_hash = g.sig_hash);
INSERT INTO honeypot_signatures AS g (sig_hash, sig_text, first_seen, last_seen, payload_count, event_count, sample_payload_hash)
SELECT p.sig_hash, min(p.sig_text), min(p.first_seen), max(p.last_seen), count(*), sum(p.count), (array_agg(p.payload_hash ORDER BY p.weight DESC NULLS LAST, p.first_seen))[1]
FROM honeypot_payloads p
WHERE p.sig_hash IN (SELECT DISTINCT x.sig_hash FROM honeypot_payloads x WHERE x.sig_hash IS NOT NULL AND (x.last_seen > now() - interval '2 days' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM honeypot_signatures y WHERE y.sig_hash = x.sig_hash)))
GROUP BY p.sig_hash
ON CONFLICT (sig_hash) DO UPDATE SET first_seen = EXCLUDED.first_seen, last_seen = EXCLUDED.last_seen, payload_count = EXCLUDED.payload_count, event_count = EXCLUDED.event_count, sample_payload_hash = EXCLUDED.sample_payload_hash;
UPDATE honeypot_signatures g SET alert_count = x.n, first_alerted = x.f, last_alerted = x.l, technique = COALESCE(g.technique, x.t)
FROM (SELECT sig_hash, count(*) AS n, min(analysed_at) AS f, max(analysed_at) AS l, max(analysis->>'technique') AS t FROM honeypot_payloads WHERE notified AND sig_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sig_hash) x
WHERE g.sig_hash = x.sig_hash AND g.alert_count = 0;
INSERT INTO honeypot_iocs (ioc, first_seen, last_seen, payload_count, first_payload, alerted_at)
SELECT k, min(p.first_seen), max(p.last_seen), count(*), min(p.payload_hash), max(CASE WHEN p.notified THEN p.analysed_at END)
FROM honeypot_payloads p, unnest(p.ioc_keys) AS k
WHERE p.analysed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.analysis->>'skipped' IS NULL
GROUP BY k
ON CONFLICT (ioc) DO NOTHING;
UPDATE honeypot_payloads p SET analysis = s.analysis || jsonb_build_object('inherited_from', s.payload_hash, 'sig_hash', p.sig_hash), interest = s.interest, analysed_at = now()
FROM honeypot_signatures g, honeypot_payloads s
WHERE p.analysed_at IS NULL AND p.sig_hash IS NOT NULL AND g.sig_hash = p.sig_hash
  AND s.payload_hash = (SELECT x.payload_hash FROM honeypot_payloads x WHERE x.sig_hash = p.sig_hash AND x.analysed_at IS NOT NULL AND x.analysis->>'inherited_from' IS NULL AND x.analysis->>'skipped' IS NULL ORDER BY x.interest DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
  AND (g.alert_count > 0 OR COALESCE(s.interest, 0) < 40)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.ioc_keys) AS k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM honeypot_iocs i WHERE i.ioc = k));
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM honeypot_signatures) AS signatures, (SELECT count(*) FROM honeypot_payloads WHERE analysed_at IS NULL) AS pending, (SELECT count(*) FROM honeypot_payloads WHERE analysis->>'inherited_from' IS NOT NULL) AS inherited;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [JSON.stringify({ sigs: $('Parse Analysis').all().map((i) => i.json.sig_hash).filter(Boolean), iocs: [].concat(...$('Parse Analysis').all().map((i) => i.json.ioc_keys || [])) })] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(g.sig_hash, jsonb_build_object('payload_count', g.payload_count, 'event_count', g.event_count, 'first_seen', g.first_seen, 'alert_count', g.alert_count, 'last_alerted', g.last_alerted)), '{}'::jsonb)
     FROM honeypot_signatures g WHERE g.sig_hash IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'sigs'))) AS sigs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(i.ioc, jsonb_build_object('alerted_at', i.alerted_at, 'payload_count', i.payload_count)), '{}'::jsonb)
     FROM honeypot_iocs i WHERE i.ioc IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'iocs'))) AS iocs;

nodeGroups.name: Extract and dedupe
nodeGroups.description: Group events by canonical payload, static IOC extraction, md5-keyed upsert into honeypot_payloads, PHP and pure path-traversal payloads skipped.

nodeGroups.name: Signatures
nodeGroups.description: Shape signature per payload (nonces, JWTs, IPs, OAST hosts stripped). Known signatures without new IOCs inherit analysis, no LLM.

nodeGroups.name: LLM analysis
nodeGroups.description: Up to 8 unanalysed payloads per run, heaviest first.

nodeGroups.name: Seen before?
nodeGroups.description: Suppress if signature alerted in last 30d unless it carries a never-alerted IOC; one alert per signature per batch.

nodeGroups.name: Persist analysis
nodeGroups.description: Analysis, notified flag, signature alert stats and IOC ledger.
